clause: Blur family - GPU pin/gallery blurs + shared bokeh styling (GPU-required) [STU-FX-013]

scope.summary: Implement the GPU pin/gallery blurs with on-canvas pin/handle controls exposed also as headless typed data: Lens Blur (depth-map + iris blades/rotation/curvature + specular), Depth-of-Field Blur (radial/linear in-focus region), Spin Blur (rotational around movable centers), Field Blur (multi-pin blur gradient), Iris Blur (elliptical sharp-focus + feathered falloff), Tilt-Shift Blur (sharpness band + distortion), Path Blur (motion along editable multi-point paths, speed/taper/end-velocity), Background Blur (backdrop, render_scope=below), Progressive Blur (gradient blur ramp, backdrop-capable), plus the shared Bokeh/Motion/Noise styling row (light bokeh, bokeh color, light range, strobe, restored grain). All GPU-Req: real-GPU proof + EFFECT_GPU_UNAVAILABLE headless fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Lens, Depth-of-Field, Spin, Field, Iris, Tilt-Shift, Path, Background(backdrop), Progressive blurs + Bokeh/Motion/Noise styling; real-GPU proof + headless fallback
expected_tests: real-GPU: Lens/Iris/Field/Tilt-Shift/Path/Spin/Background/Progressive blur render + pin controls as typed data
test: Background/Progressive read backdrop (render_scope=below); bokeh styling shared params

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Pin-based cinematic blur set missing; backdrop blur unavailable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
